items.credits: Bodies, Boat Story, Platform 7, Marvel's Secret Invasion
items.facilities: Four stages from 10,500 to 27,000 sq ft, prop stores, workshops, wardrobe, hair/makeup studio, green room, two car parks with EV charging

items.name: Wall to Wall
items.summary: Factual and drama producer headquartered on Old Street in London with offices in Bristol and Manchester, making programmes since 1987.
items.services: Factual series, factual entertainment, history and arts documentaries, television drama
items.credits: Glow Up: Britain's Next Make-up Star, Waterloo Road, Lucy Worsley's Victorian Murder Club, Back to the Frontier, L.S Lowry: The Unheard Tapes

items.name: Wardpark Film and Television Studios
items.summary: Scotland's fully integrated film studio complex at Cumbernauld, with five sound stages and on-site accommodation for cast and crew.
items.facilities: A Stage 13,000 sq ft x 40 ft; B Stage 12,000 sq ft x 21 ft; C Stage 11,500 sq ft x 26 ft; D Stage 11,500 sq ft x 26 ft; E Stage 5,000 sq ft x 18 ft. 300 parking spaces, on-site accommodation, 24/7 security.

items.name: Warner Bros. Studios Leavesden
items.summary: A former aerodrome converted into one of Europe's largest film studios, with lettered and numbered stages, a large water tank and an extensive backlot.
items.credits: Harry Potter film series, GoldenEye, Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace, The Dark Knight
items.facilities: 350,000 sq ft of sound stages across lettered stages (A to V) and numbered stages (1 to 11); Europe's largest interior water tank; a backlot of more than 55 acres; dedicated mill and multi-function workshop buildings; executive, production and art department offices; on-site set lighting, rigging and De Lane Lea sound post-production.

items.name: West London Film Studios
items.summary: A two-site studio complex in Hayes with ten stages in total, including the UK's only permanent standing hospital set.
items.credits: Ted Lasso, Killing Eve, The Father, Venom: The Last Dance, Good Omens, Bohemian Rhapsody, The Imitation Game
items.facilities: Springfield site: 6 sound stages, over 40,000 sq ft of stage space, 70+ production/office rooms, on-site cafeteria for 300+ crew. Parkside site: 4 stages, Stages 7 and 10 over 13,000 sq ft each with 38 ft ceiling height, Stages 8 and 9 over 11,000 sq ft each. 85,000 sq ft of soundproof stage space in total across both sites, 77+ office rooms, a permanent hospital set standing on site.

items.name: Wolf Studios Wales
items.summary: A producer-built Cardiff studio complex of seven sound-treated stages and a serviced backlot, run by the production company Bad Wolf.
items.credits: Doctor Who, His Dark Materials, A Discovery of Witches, Industry
items.facilities: 7 stages totalling 137,000 sq ft: Stage 1 21,661 sq ft (32-41 ft); Stage 2 14,531 sq ft (35-41 ft); Stage 3 14,531 sq ft (35-41 ft); Stage 4 27,000 sq ft (35-41 ft); Stage 5 20,000 sq ft (35-41 ft); Stage 6 24,497 sq ft, 57.5 ft (tallest stage); Stage 7 15,000 sq ft (32-41 ft). All stages A-rated for sound with scene docks 13 x 16.4 ft. 69,000 sq ft serviced backlot; 13 edit suites; 2 costume workshops; flexible offices; props storage and fabrication.

items.name: Working Title Films
items.summary: London film company producing feature films, television and theatre since 1984, with a second office in Los Angeles and more than 130 films to its name.
items.services: Feature film production, television production, theatre production
items.credits: Four Weddings and a Funeral, Notting Hill, Fargo, Bean, Billy Elliot the Musical
